SCE.S:285054: Helped found the hospital. Moved to the mountains when his wife died. Fascinated by changes of body and mind.
SCE.S:28FAD8: Who are you!? ...Who are you!? A reporter? ...What business do you have with an old man living alone this deep in the mountains? About a glowing object that fell? Did Martians invade or something? Nonsense! ...Get out, now!
SCE.S:28FC54: You're carrying a weapon, aren't you? Don't underestimate me just because I'm old. I'll show no mercy!
SCE.S:28FD54: Satisfied? Get out of here! You press people don't know the first thing about manners.
SCE.S:28FEB4: Hey! How far in do you think you're going? There's nothing here to satisfy your curiosity!
SCE.S:2900AC: Which newspaper are you from!? I can sue you for trespassing, you know!
SCE.S:290248: Are you... in your right mind!? What do you plan to do getting into a stranger's bath!?
SCE.S:29035C: {5}A little cloudy water has pooled in the bathtub. Something like jelly-like skin floats at the bottom.
SCE.S:290490: That's the cellar! It's just full of junk. Mementos, to me, though.
SCE.S:2905FC: It's locked, you say? I have no intention of opening it for you. Come on, let's go upstairs.
SCE.S:290714: I have nothing to say to you!
SCE.S:29079C: I have nothing to say to you!
SCE.S:292BC0: {5}The old man seems to be gone. But there's wood in the fireplace. And... something stirs beneath the floor.
SCE.S:292CC4: {5}Ragged breathing comes from beyond the cellar door.
SCE.S:292E80: {6}You've seen me. ...As you can see, this is how I am. ...I'll tell you everything. ...To the west of here, a primeval fir forest spreads. Above the treetops... about 30 meters up, I saw a strong light. It hung in the air for about fifteen minutes, then slowly descended. That "ship" had one crew member. He looked almost no different from an Earthling. He seemed weak and unable to move. I took him home. When I laid him on the bed, his mind flowed straight into my brain. ...An enormous amount of information. For a moment, I couldn't tell where I was. When I came to, he was gone. And I had been "infected." That's how it all began. ...But... my aged body couldn't adapt to the "change." My whole body aches dully. ...Please kill me!
SCE.S:2931D8: {6}I can hardly move anymore. Let me sleep in peace... ...Please.
SCE.S:293294: {5}There are signs the old man was in the cellar. But he no longer seems to exist in this world.
SCE.S:29538C: {5}The old man's body is gone. Did the police take it away, or did it evaporate?
